editorial:
When your brother-in-law messes up a drug deal, you might have to dust off your old smuggling skills to fix it. That's exactly what happens to Chris Farraday, a former smuggler who thought he left that life behind. Now a family man, he gets pulled back in to pay off a dangerous debt. The movie throws you right into the action, with Chris planning a risky job while trying to protect his wife and kids from angry criminals. It feels like a solid heist thriller with real stakes, where every decision could get someone killed.

Mark Wahlberg carries the movie with his usual tough-guy charm, and the action scenes keep things moving at a good clip. The pacing is tight, though some plot twists feel a bit too convenient. Still, the tension stays high, and the supporting cast adds some fun energy. If you enjoy crime thrillers with a blue-collar hero, this one is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, Chris pulls off a clever double-cross. He secretly swaps the counterfeit money for real cash hidden in a van, tricking the drug lord into thinking the deal failed. The cops close in, but Chris escapes with his family. His brother-in-law is safe, and the bad guys get arrested. Chris walks away clean, proving he still has his old skills.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime thrillers with a blue-collar hero
